scope: security-only (user-requested focused re-run, not the full 12-pillar audit)

pillars.title: Security

criteria.statement: Least-privilege IAM (no wildcard * actions/resources without justification).
criteria.notes: Webhook/worker roles well-scoped with conditions; Bedrock InvokeModel Resource broader than the two models actually configured (SEC-F4).

criteria.statement: No long-lived credentials/secrets in code or state; use of Secrets Manager/SSM/roles.
criteria.notes: GitHub App short-lived tokens preferred; Secrets Manager values set out-of-band with ignore_changes.

criteria.statement: Encryption at rest on all data stores.
criteria.notes: SSE-SQS, S3 SSE-KMS, ECR AES256, DynamoDB/Secrets Manager default encryption; AWS-managed keys, not CMK (SEC-07).

criteria.statement: Encryption in transit (TLS) enforced; no plaintext endpoints.
criteria.notes: API Gateway TLS-only; CloudFront origin https-only/TLSv1.2 and viewer https-only.
No VPC/security groups/VPC endpoints anywhere; fully public serverless design, architecturally justified but unsegmented.

criteria.statement: No public exposure of data stores/admin surfaces unless justified.
criteria.notes: S3 public access block; only the webhook API is public, by design, now behind CloudFront+WAF, and authenticity-gated.

criteria.statement: KMS CMK usage & key rotation where appropriate.
criteria.notes: CMK removed account-wide due to an org-level DENY on kms:CreateKey (SEC-F2).
HMAC verified before any processing, on both the CloudFront and the raw API Gateway entry path.
Tar-slip/symlink protections; no shell/subprocess calls; parameterized boto3 calls.

criteria.statement: Detective controls (CloudTrail, Config, GuardDuty, Security Hub) enabled.
criteria.notes: New WAF CloudWatch logging/metrics at the webhook edge is a real but narrow improvement; no account-wide CloudTrail/Config/GuardDuty/Security Hub (SEC-F3).
ECR scan_on_push + digest-pinned deploys, but Python deps unpinned (SEC-F5).

criteria.statement: Secrets not logged; PII handling & redaction.
criteria.notes: Logs only dict keys, never secret values.
No CI/CD pipeline exists; nothing to assess.
Distinct webhook/worker/runtime_execution roles, each minimally scoped, no sharing.

strengths.text: WAFv2 (managed Core Rule Set + Known Bad Inputs + per-IP rate limit) now sits in front of the public webhook via CloudFront, with logging/metrics enabled.
Recent IAM tightening holds up on fresh read.
Webhook authenticity enforced with a constant-time HMAC-SHA256 check on both entry paths.
Per-service IAM roles with no sharing across webhook, worker, and runtime_execution.
No long-lived static credentials; GitHub App with short-lived installation tokens preferred over PAT.
All data stores encrypted at rest with AWS-managed keys.

findings.title: WAF/CloudFront front now in place, but the raw API Gateway origin remains directly reachable (residual bypass)
findings.impact: Traffic sent directly to the execute-api URL skips WAF managed rules and the WAF rate rule, though it remains bound by API Gateway's stage throttle and must still pass HMAC verification before any state-changing action — no unauthenticated write path exists via either route. Downgraded from Medium (prior run) to Low.
findings.recommendation: Add a shared-secret custom header set only by CloudFront's origin custom headers, checked in the Lambda before HMAC verification.

alternative.summary: CloudFront origin custom-header verification vs. accepting current residual risk
pros: Closes the bypass at negligible cost/complexity
Standard AWS pattern for CloudFront-only origins
cons: One more secret to rotate and keep in sync

findings.title: No customer-managed KMS keys (CMK); blocked at the account level
findings.impact: All encryption uses AWS-managed/owned keys; no customer-controlled key policy, no configurable rotation, coarser CloudTrail key-usage attribution.
findings.recommendation: Request narrow kms:CreateKey/key-management permissions, then re-enable kms_key_id and enable rotation.

cons: Currently blocked by an org-level IAM deny

findings.title: No account/project-level detective controls (CloudTrail, Config, GuardDuty, Security Hub)
findings.impact: No centralized, immutable audit trail of API/IAM activity outside the webhook's own new WAF logs.
findings.recommendation: Enable a baseline CloudTrail trail and metric filters/alarms on IAM/Secrets Manager access; consider GuardDuty.

alternative.summary: None — a baseline CloudTrail trail is a foundational, low-cost control.

findings.title: Bedrock model-invoke permission scoped wider than the models actually used
findings.impact: Runtime role can invoke any foundation model in any region.
findings.recommendation: Scope the BedrockInvoke Resource to the two configured model ARNs/region.

findings.title: Unpinned Python dependencies, no lockfile
findings.impact: Builds not reproducible; may silently pick up vulnerable dependency versions.
findings.recommendation: Pin exact versions or use a lockfile; add pip-audit/Dependabot.

improvements.text: Enable a baseline CloudTrail trail plus metric filters/alarms (SEC-F3)
Add a CloudFront origin custom-header check in the webhook Lambda (SEC-F1)
Scope Bedrock InvokeModel resource to configured model ARNs (SEC-F4)
Pin Python dependency versions and add vulnerability scanning (SEC-F5)
Reintroduce customer-managed KMS keys once unblocked (SEC-F2)

pillars.notes: Static analysis only (live_aws=OFF). Focused single-pillar re-run following commit 6abcd3a which implemented the prior run's SEC-F1 finding. SEC-F1 independently re-verified: WAF/CloudFront correctly built, but a residual direct-origin bypass remains (retained as Low). SEC-F2/F4/F5 re-verified fresh and unchanged. No Critical findings; no capping. terraform validate/plan not run (time-boxed). AWS Documentation MCP not available this session.

roadmap.action: Enable a baseline CloudTrail trail + metric filters/alarms on IAM/Secrets Manager activity
Add a CloudFront origin custom-header check in the webhook Lambda to reject direct API Gateway traffic
Scope the Bedrock InvokeModel resource to the two configured model ARNs and region
Pin Python dependencies with a lock file; enable Dependabot/pip-audit
Reintroduce customer-managed KMS keys once the account-level kms:CreateKey deny is lifted
